name: list
title: List
description: The list a row sits in: a `<ul>` (list and listitem roles on device) that wraps each element of `contentSlot` in its own cell, with a `label` for its accessible name, a rule between rows (`divided`, on by default) and the padding around each row. Holds `ListItem`s, `DisclosureRow`s or rows of your own.
